g.text: A goal outside the stage is flagged, not blocked — the author keeps the choice
A task that does not lead to the goal is flagged when the author sends the edits — on day 1 and on day 15 alike
Sprint reviews and the verdict read the plan in force: day 1 until call 3, the revision after it
A task without matching evidence is not done; the verdict follows from that
the path of stages ends in release
